title: 67 ##### 4.3.2 Disposal of persons arrested under the Local and Special Laws by the courts A total of 36,32,398 persons were under trial during 1974 including under-trials carried over from the previous year, 29·2 per cent of the total under-trials remained under arrest at the end of the year pending completion of trial. 86·8 per cent of the total persons under-trial to total persons in whose cases trials were completed were convicted during the year. The percentage of conviction to total persons whose trials were completed was consistently high and generally above 70·0 per cent for most of the offences but under the 'Corruption Act' and 'Explosive Act and Explosive Substance Act' it was only 42·9 per cent and 60·1 per cent respectively. The relevant statistics are presented in Table 29.
